name: What are the benefits of re-coating stucco versus patching or repainting?
description: Re-coating provides uniform protection and aesthetic renewal, unlike patching which is for isolated damage, or repainting which only changes color.

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of re-coating stucco versus patching or repainting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Re-coating stucco offers more comprehensive benefits than simple patching or repainting. While patching addresses isolated damage, it doesn't provide uniform protection or aesthetic renewal for the entire surface. Repainting can change color but doesn't restore the stucco's protective properties or fill hairline cracks effectively. Re-coating applies a new, continuous layer that rejuvenates the entire façade, improves weather resistance, and often seals small imperfections, leading to a more durable and aesthetically pleasing finish.
